in_marathi.name: Ilavia
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Ila's Abode
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ilavia हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ilavia is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ila-vās’, which means ‘the abode of Goddess Ila’. In Hindu mythology, Goddess Ila is known for her kindness, grace, and compassion. The name Ilavia is believed to bring these divine qualities to the one who bears it.
